contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: If text fits limit, return it unchanged. Otherwise keep the first limit minus marker-length code points and append marker. The marker itself must fit the limit.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Limit is an integer from 0 through 64 and marker length is at most limit.

inputRoles.limit: maximum total output code points including marker
inputRoles.marker: suffix used only when shortening is needed

contract.outputRole: bounded display text including any marker
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
